description: Source code for an authentication service module implementing user registration, login, JWT handling, and password normalization/validation logic.

classes.name: AuthServiceError
classes.description: Base class for exceptions related to the authentication service.

classes.name: InvalidCredentialsError
classes.description: Raised when user provides invalid login credentials.

classes.name: TokenValidationError
classes.description: Raised when JWT token validation fails or token is expired.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Main class handling user registration, authentication, token creation, and decoding.

methods.name: str _normalized_password(password: str)
methods.description: Normalizes password input by stripping surrounding whitespace without altering internal content.

methods.name: bool _password_within_bcrypt_bounds(password: str)
methods.description: Checks if the password's UTF-8 byte length is between 8 and 72.

methods.name: User register_user(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Registers a new user with normalized password, enforcing bcrypt byte-length constraints.

methods.name: Tuple[User,str] authenticate_user(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Authenticates user with email and password, returning user object and JWT token.

methods.name: str _create_access_token(self, *, subject: str)
methods.description: Creates a JWT token with subject claim, using configured expiration and secret.

methods.name: TokenPayload decode_token(self, token: str)
methods.description: Decodes and validates JWT token, raising errors if invalid or expired.

methods.name: Optional[User] get_user_by_id(self, db: Session, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their database ID.

ctags.name: authenticate_user
ctags.pattern: /^    def authenticate_user(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str) -> Tuple[User, str]:$/
ctags.signature: (self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)

ctags.name: get_user_by_id
ctags.pattern: /^    def get_user_by_id(self, db: Session, user_id: int) -> Optional[User]:$/

ctags.name: register_user
ctags.pattern: /^    def register_user(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str) -> User:$/
ctags.signature: (self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)
